packageRules.description: Nix flake input updates run on Saturdays — no automerge, review manually to catch Caddy plugin hash changes
Automerge container image digest updates after CI passes
Ignore postgres major version bumps — requires manual data migration

Freeze the Home Assistant image while the native migration is staged. services.home-assistant can only take over when nixpkgs >= the running version; both are 2026.7.4 as of 2026-08-01, and letting the container roll forward to 2026.8.x would reopen that gate for another month. RE-ENABLE once modules/homeassistant.nix no longer declares this container.
